hypothesis: Exhaustively extend the finite equal-weight formula grammar from nine to ten prior-only features. A Discovery→Validation-selected ten-feature formula may improve blind number-hit ranking over a nine-feature formula selected by the identical procedure on the same canonical archive and chronological splits. Blind OOS must not be used for candidate selection.

formula_universe.enumeration: lexicographic combinations over the registered 27 prior-only feature columns
formula_universe.shard_partition: contiguous lexicographic formula-rank intervals; ranks 0..8436284 exactly once, no gaps/overlaps

walkforward.split_rule: discovery if target_offset/scored_targets < 0.60; validation if <0.80; else blind_oos
walkforward.prior_only_cutoff: For target archive index i, every feature uses draws[0:i] only; record cutoff date i-1; rank all 40 numbers before reading/scoring target i; update state only after scoring.
walkforward.scoring_rule: At each target prefix, z-score each of the 27 registered features across numbers 1..40; score each unordered ten-feature subset by equal-weight arithmetic mean of its ten standardized columns.
walkforward.retrospective_best_formula: Descriptive upper bound only; never an ex-ante forecast or candidate-selection rule.

candidate_selection.rule: Within each formula universe, Discovery top-100 by mean number_hits_top5; tie-break lower mean rank then lexicographic formula_id; select one on Validation with the same tie-break. Freeze Q92 and Q89 candidates before Blind OOS.
candidate_selection.q89_control_requirement: Re-run the nine-feature catalog/selection on this exact 2026-11-08 archive and split layout. Do not reuse Q89 candidate selected from the 2026-11-07 archive.

primary_comparison.endpoint: paired difference in Blind OOS Top-5 number-hit share, Q92 candidate minus Q89 control

absolute_uniform_baseline_gate.endpoint: Selected Q92 candidate Blind OOS mean number_hits_top5
absolute_uniform_baseline_gate.raw_p_value_method: Discrete upper-tail convolution of iid Hypergeometric(40,5,5) hit counts over the 670 fixed Blind OOS targets.
absolute_uniform_baseline_gate.multiplicity: Use the selected candidate's Top-5 adjusted p-value from the already registered global Holm family of 75,926,565 formula×split×endpoint tests; do not create a second uncorrected test.
absolute_uniform_baseline_gate.criterion: Mean number_hits_top5 must be strictly greater than 0.125 AND the selected candidate's global Holm-adjusted Blind OOS Top-5 p-value must be <0.05.
absolute_uniform_baseline_gate.interpretation: A paired lift over Q89 alone is relative evidence and does not establish absolute above-uniform predictive value.

multiple_testing.method: Global Holm-Bonferroni across the complete formula×split×endpoint family
multiple_testing.calculation: 8436285 formulas × 3 chronological splits × 3 primary catalog endpoints
multiple_testing.p_value_method: discrete upper-tail convolution of iid Hypergeometric(40,k,5) number-hit counts; deterministic float64 under independent uniform 5-of-40 draws
multiple_testing.limitation: Holm is valid under arbitrary dependence only when input p-values are valid; finite-population normal approximation and lottery-independence assumptions remain limitations.

protocol_amendments.supersedes: Continuity-corrected normal upper-tail approximation to summed Hypergeometric(40,k,5) number-hit counts.
protocol_amendments.amended_method: discrete upper-tail convolution of iid Hypergeometric(40,k,5) number-hit counts; deterministic float64 under independent uniform 5-of-40 draws
protocol_amendments.rationale: Full-support audit found relative tail errors near first Holm threshold up to 68.22% for Top-5 at 670 targets and 49.48% for Top-5 at 2012 targets. Discrete convolution improves calibration without changing formula universe, features, chronological split, selection or paired endpoints.

protocol_amendments.row_order: split-major; formula-rank ascending within split; split and formula rank implicit
protocol_amendments.replay: reconstruct mean metrics and discrete exact raw p-values from integer sufficient statistics; replay global Holm in deterministic formula×split×endpoint order and compare raw/adjusted vector SHA-256
protocol_amendments.rationale: Compact sufficient statistics remove redundant formula IDs, feature strings, split/target labels, derived means and row-level adjusted p-values while preserving deterministic replay. Acceptance validator and exact-byte persister remain mandatory.

protocol_amendments.supersedes: Full stable argsort rank matrix for all 40 numbers per formula batch.
protocol_amendments.amended_method: Exact selective rank extraction for each of the five actual numbers against all 40 prior-only number scores; lower-number priority on exact ties.
protocol_amendments.limitation: Synthetic compute-performance evidence only; no historical lottery outcome or split metric used.

protocol_amendments.hypothesis: Among the preregistered selective-rank batch sizes 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096, batch 2048 maximizes median throughput against the full stable argsort baseline while preserving exact rank parity.
protocol_amendments.limitation: Hosted-runner timing is environment-specific and is not predictive evidence.

protocol_amendments.primary_endpoint: paired Blind OOS Top-5 hit-share difference Q92 minus same-archive Q89 control
protocol_amendments.decision_rule: mean_delta_top5 >= 0.005 AND Holm-adjusted block sign-flip p < 0.05 AND 95% circular moving-block bootstrap CI lower > 0
protocol_amendments.practical_interpretation: 0.5 percentage-point Top-5 hit-share gain, approximately 17 additional number hits over 670 Blind OOS draws (3,350 actual-number observations).
protocol_amendments.rationale: Avoid accepting a statistically significant but practically negligible gain; require a preregistered minimum effect before examining Q92 Blind OOS.
protocol_amendments.limitation: This is a decision gate, not a claim of expected predictive gain.

protocol_amendments.rationale: The registered paired primary comparison is against a Q89 candidate whose prior same-archive Blind OOS Top-5 share is below the uniform expectation of 0.125. A positive paired lift of at least 0.005 could therefore still leave Q92 below uniform. The aggregate previously computed the global Holm vector but did not expose the selected candidate's adjusted p-values, making the absolute baseline comparison difficult to audit.
protocol_amendments.method: Persist the selected candidate's raw and global Holm-adjusted p-values for all three endpoints and all three splits. Compute the selected candidate's Blind OOS absolute-baseline evidence from its Top-5 share and its existing globally Holm-adjusted Top-5 p-value.
protocol_amendments.criterion: mean number_hits_top5 > 0.125 AND global Holm-adjusted selected-candidate Blind OOS Top-5 p-value < 0.05.
